_comment: Lebanon NGO/international-organization pitch. User's exact fixed copy, no signal variation. Salutation slot is the only change from the source text. No em-dashes. Renders through email_template.py at send.
subject_template: The time your team loses on donor reports
body_template:
Hi {salutation},

Hope you and the team are doing well. Spending time around the sector, I've noticed the same thing in almost every organization: the people hired to run programs end up cleaning field data by hand and rewriting the same results into a different template for each donor. Reporting season swallows entire weeks, and it comes straight out of program time.

I'm David Geha, a third year Engineering student at AUB, and I work with OSG (https://osgdev.com). We're AI consultants: we find where an organization is losing time and build AI systems around those exact gaps. We've done this for marketing agencies, F&B businesses and oil and gas companies across Lebanon and the GCC.

Would you have 20 minutes this week for a call so we can go through the details? If it's simpler, you can reach me directly on +961 76 412 978.

Kind regards,
David Geha
OSG
https://osgdev.com
